texts.text: Do you need to create strong threads in weak materials such as light metals or plastics? Threaded inserts are the solution of choice for this use case.

texts.text: Watch the video to learn about the different types of threaded inserts and their use cases.
Depending on the application, different types of threaded inserts are available. At Bossard, we distinguish between the following types:
Heavy-duty threaded inserts with special key-locks
Mold-in, screw-in, or press-in threaded inserts
You can also differentiate threaded inserts based on the parent material to be used:
Threaded inserts for metal, such as aluminum or zinc die-casting
Threaded inserts for plastic materials such as composites, thermoplastics, and thermosets
We supply a broad portfolio of branded threaded inserts, including the following:
Compression LimitersFASTEKS® FCLLimit compressive forces on molded plastic parts and protect your material by preventing overloading.
Limit compressive forces on molded plastic parts and protect your material by preventing overloading.
Wire Threaded InsertsFILTEC®Create high-strength threads with optimal transmission from the bolt to the nut thread.
Create high-strength threads with optimal transmission from the bolt to the nut thread.
Wire Threaded InsertsKATO®Ideal for threads subjected to heavy loads, connections that need to be disassembled frequently, or repairing damaged threads.
Ideal for threads subjected to heavy loads, connections that need to be disassembled frequently, or repairing damaged threads.
High-Strength Threaded Inserts Keenserts®Extremely durable stainless steel threaded inserts. Prevent threads from becoming stripped or replace damaged threads.
Extremely durable stainless steel threaded inserts. Prevent threads from becoming stripped or replace damaged threads.
Brass, steel, or stainless steel threaded inserts for press-in, screw-in, or mold-in applications in plastic or wood. Versatile and anti-corrosion.
The products listed here may not be available in all countries. In case of questions, please contact us.
